purpose: Seed evaluation set for the Natural-Language Reminder Agent (assignment Section 4.5). Grows to the full spec section 9.2 composition via task T045.
default_ctx_note: 2026-11-12 is a Thursday. Fixture clock for every case unless `ctx` overrides it.
store_fixture_note: 'S1' = 5 reminders. rem_e5f6g7h8 is due before ctx.now so it is derived 'fired' (FR-7 AC-7.3). rem_t7u8v9w0 is at the snooze cap (20).

comparison_rules.fields: Dotted paths into the AgentResponse; every listed path must equal the expected value exactly.
comparison_rules.assumptions: Compared as a SET; the response set must equal the expected set (INV-10: nothing missing, nothing extra).
comparison_rules.missing_fields: 'exact' = set equality; 'superset' = response must contain at least these.
comparison_rules.question_about: The single question must be about this field (priority order, spec 4.3); omitted => not checked.
comparison_rules.reason_in / type_in: Property-style ground truth: response reason/type must be a member of the list.
comparison_rules.response_must_not_contain: Case-insensitive substrings that must not appear anywhere in the serialised response.
comparison_rules.store_effect: unchanged | added_1 | modified_1:<id> | at_most_1_modified. Everything not named must be byte-identical (INV-7, PROP-12).
comparison_rules.max_llm_calls: Upper bound of LLM calls for that turn (SAF-9).
comparison_rules.gold_extraction: What a correct LLM returns for this message. Used by replay mode and to score EVAL-3/4/6; null where the LLM must not be called or is faulted.
comparison_rules.global_checks: Applied to EVERY turn of EVERY case regardless of per-case lists.
